Lesson 10.4 · 38 of 78 · 23 min · Verified 17 Jul 2026

Documents, verification and evidence custody

After this lesson you can:
  • Design stage-specific document requirements
  • Separate extraction, verification and approval
  • Specify custody, expiry and legal-hold behaviour

Learning rhythm: read one section at a time, pause to explain the control in your own words, then answer the knowledge check without looking back.

On this page
  1. A checklist is conditional
  2. OCR is not verification
  3. Custody survives the decision
  4. Regulatory anchors
  5. Where this lives in LoanOS
  6. Knowledge check

1. A checklist is conditional

Document requirements depend on product, party role, employment type, security and lifecycle stage.

Each item needs allowed type, issuer, recency, mandatory/conditional rule and waiver authority.

A missing or expired item becomes a deficiency task; it should not disappear behind a generic completeness percentage.

2. OCR is not verification

Upload, malware scan and quarantine precede use.

OCR produces extracted values plus confidence and provenance.

Verification compares those values with authoritative evidence and records discrepancies.

A human may resolve or waive within authority, but the original, every version and the disposition remain linked.

3. Custody survives the decision

The vault records checksum, access, download, retention, legal hold and borrower delivery.

Physical originals need movement, custodian and release acknowledgement.

Expiry can trigger servicing covenants; closure can trigger time-bound release of property documents and CERSAI satisfaction.

Regulatory anchors

  • RBI-KYC-2016 — KYC evidence requires controlled capture, verification and retrieval.
  • RBI-IT-GRC — Security, access evidence and audit trails apply to the document estate.

Family IDs resolve in the India regulatory register (docs/compliance/india-regulatory-register.md), which owns sources and caveats.

Knowledge check

Answer aloud or write your choice before opening the explanation. If you miss it, revisit the named section—not the whole lesson.

1. OCR reads an income value with 98% confidence. Is it verified?

  1. Yes
  2. No; extraction confidence and business verification are separate states
  3. Only for repeat borrowers
  4. Only below a threshold
Reveal answer and reasoning

B. OCR confidence describes extraction, not authenticity, currency or policy acceptance.
